body.objective: Repair the remaining production inconsistency in typed terminal-outcome dependencies after SF17 was marked LANDED.  In the real physics programme, `s-f work ready` correctly strips `#ANY_TERMINAL` and offers the observer successor after its predecessor reached DONE, but `s-f work show` passes the raw suffixed identifier to program lookup and reports `UNRESOLVED ... (not found in program)`.  All read-only and mutating coordination surfaces must fold the same dependency semantics or agents will diagnose a healthy queue as broken.
body.stop_condition: On the committed physics fixture, work-show, work-ready, work-pull preflight, work-package, overview, streams-view and dependency graph construction must parse the dependency base id and mode once through the same canonical helper.  For observer-berger-apparatus-physical-reduction-after-replacement-112, the DONE predecessor must display SATISFIED with mode ANY_TERMINAL and the successor must remain READY/pullable.  Add controls proving that OBSTRUCTED satisfies ANY_TERMINAL but not SUCCESS_TERMINAL, DONE satisfies both, ACTIVE satisfies neither, and a genuinely unknown base id remains unresolved.  The regression gate must run against a directory-native multi-file programme, not only a synthetic in-memory node pair.
body.forbid: no removal of the typed suffix from authored dependencies; no prose-only suppression of the work-show warning; no treating every terminal state as success; no automatic readiness for unknown base ids; no mutation during read-only inspection; no real work pull in the regression test; no physics-specific observer id hard-coded in the implementation
notes: Minimal reproduction from physics/symplectic-reconstruction at commit 9dccd21f2 or later: `s-f work ready --stream observer --now 2026-07-20T22:50:00+02:00` prints the physical-reduction item READY, while `s-f work show --item observer-berger-apparatus-physical-reduction-after-replacement-112 --now 2026-07-20T22:50:00+02:00` prints `UNRESOLVED sf:program/work/observer-berger-apparatus-combined-q1-after-replacement-112#ANY_TERMINAL (not found in program)`.
SF17/fe14c02a7 established the intended semantics, so this is a missed consumer path/regression rather than a new feature request.
The queue is not presently scientifically blocked because work-ready and the prior pull path resolve correctly, but the contradictory inspection surface is unsafe for resident-agent diagnosis.
